50End Matter · FAQs

Interview FAQs

ML systems interviews me aksar poochhe jaane wale sawaal — jawab Hinglish me, book ke concepts par based. Kisi bhi sawaal par click karo, jawab khul jayega.

Q01ML system aur ML model me kya farq hai?
Model sirf algorithm hota hai — jaise ek classifier ya regressor. ML system poora package hota hai: user interface, data stack, hardware backend, aur development, deployment, monitoring aur update karne ka infrastructure. Interview me yeh bolna important hai ki algorithm poori system ka chhota sa hissa hai — data, features, serving aur monitoring ke bina model ka koi matlab nahi.
Q02Kab ML use nahi karna chahiye?
Jab patterns na hon, data na ho, problem predictive na ho, ya simple rules kaam kar jayein — tab ML mat use karo. ML tabhi jab kaam repetitive ho, galat prediction sasti ho, problem scale par ho, aur patterns badalte rehte hon. Agar ek galti catastrophic ho sakti hai, to ML akele kaafi nahi — wahan human oversight chahiye.
Q03Research aur production ML me sabse bada farq kya hai?
Research me data clean aur static hota hai, goal sirf leaderboard score hota hai, aur throughput matter karta hai. Production me data messy aur constantly shifting hota hai, kai stakeholders ke alag goals hote hain, latency critical hoti hai, aur fairness aur interpretability zaroori hote hain. Research me jo model jeetta hai, woh production me fail ho sakta hai kyunki wahan data cleaning, deployment aur monitoring jaise hard steps hote hain.
Q04Latency aur throughput me kya farq hai? Dono ko ek saath kaise dekhte hain?
Latency ek query ka time hai, throughput ek time me kitni queries process hui. Batching se throughput badhta hai lekin latency badh sakti hai. Average latency misleading hoti hai — p95 aur p99 percentiles dekho, kyunki woh slowest users ka experience batate hain. SLAs aksar p99 par define hote hain, jaise p99 latency 200ms se kam.
Q05ML systems me silent failures kya hoti hain aur unhe kaise pakdein?
Traditional software crash hota hai ya error deta hai, lekin ML system galat predictions dete hue bhi chalta rehta hai — user ko pata bhi nahi chalta. Isliye monitoring zaroori hai: predictions ka distribution, accuracy (jahan labels milen), input features ka distribution, aur business metrics — sab track karo. Alerts sirf crashes par nahi, distribution shifts aur performance drops par bhi lagao.
Q06Data poisoning kya hai? Isse kaise bachein?
Data poisoning me attacker training data me malicious examples daal kar model ko kharab karta hai — jaise face recognition ko aise train karna ki woh kisi chehre ko galat pehchane. Bachne ke liye: data sources ko validate karo, data lineage track karo, anomalies detect karo, aur training data par access control rakho. Yeh attack traditional software me nahi hota — sirf ML systems me hota hai.
Q07JSON vs Parquet — kab kaunsa format use karein?
JSON text aur human-readable hai, har jagah use hota hai, nested data handle karta hai. Parquet binary aur column-major hai — column-wise access aur compression ke liye behtar hai. Book ke example me 14MB CSV Parquet me 6MB ho gayi. Large analytical workloads aur ML training data ke liye Parquet behtar hai; APIs aur config ke liye JSON behtar hai. Access pattern dekh kar choose karo — row-wise access ho to row-major, column-wise ho to column-major.
Q08Data warehouse vs data lake vs lakehouse me kya farq hai?
Warehouse me structured data predefined schema ke saath hota hai — search fast, lekin rigid. Lake me raw data bina schema ke hota hai — fast arrival, lekin search inefficient aur swamp banne ka risk. Lakehouse dono ka hybrid hai — lake ki flexibility aur warehouse ki management. Schema stable ho to warehouse, data diverse aur evolving ho to lake ya lakehouse.
Q09ETL aur ELT me kya farq hai?
ETL me pehle extract, phir transform, phir load karte ho — data destination me jaane se pehle clean aur shaped hota hai. ELT me pehle load kar do, transform baad me karo — data fast arrive karta hai. ELT tab achha hai jab data volume bahut bada ho aur schema evolve ho raha ho; ETL tab jab destination ko clean, shaped data chahiye ho. Aaj kai teams dono ka mix use karti hain.
Q10Dataflow ke 3 modes kya hain aur real-time transport kab use karein?
Databases se (aasan lekin slow, shared access chahiye), services se REST/RPC requests ke through (microservices, lekin synchronous — ek service down ho to dependent services atak jati hain), aur real-time transport se (broker/event bus — har service sirf broker se baat karti hai). Real-time transport data-heavy systems ke liye best hai; request-driven logic-heavy systems ke liye. Pubsub me koi bhi publish kar sakta hai aur subscribers saare events padhte hain; message queue me har message ke intended consumers hote hain.
Q11Batch vs stream processing — kaunsa kab?
Batch processing historical data par periodic jobs chalata hai — daily reports, model training, large aggregates. Stream processing data aate hi process karta hai — fraud detection, live recommendations, monitoring. ML me dono chahiye: training ke liye batch, online predictions ke liye stream. Interview me yeh bhi bolo ki dono pipelines ko unify karna mushkil hai aur train/serve skew ka cause banta hai.
Q12Sampling methods — random, stratified, weighted, importance — kab kaunsa?
Simple random unbiased hai lekin rare classes miss kar sakta hai. Stratified har group ki representation banaye rakhta hai — imbalanced data ke liye behtar. Weighted sampling har example ko weight ke hisaab se probability deta hai. Importance sampling tab jab sample karne wali distribution target se alag ho — weights se bias correct karta hai. Streaming data ke liye reservoir sampling use karo, jo fixed memory me uniform sample deta hai.
Q13Label multiplicity kya hai aur use kaise handle karein?
Ek hi example par alag annotators alag labels de dein — yahi label multiplicity hai. Iska matlab task ambiguous hai ya guidelines unclear hain. Handle karne ke tareeke: majority vote, soft labels (probabilities), ya guidelines sudharna. Labels ko ground truth mat samjho — woh human judgment hain, unme bias aur galtiyan ho sakti hain.
Q14Weak supervision, semi-supervision aur transfer learning me kya farq hai?
Weak supervision me labeling functions (heuristic programs) se noisy labels banaye jate hain aur combine kiye jate hain — fast aur cheap. Semi-supervision me thode labeled aur bahut saare unlabeled data ko saath use karte hain. Transfer learning me bade dataset par train hue model ko apne chhote dataset par fine-tune karte hain. Teeno ka goal ek hi hai: kam hand labels me kaam chalana.
Q15Active learning kya hai aur iska side effect kya hai?
Active learning me model khud batata hai ki kaunse examples label karne se sabse zyada fayda hoga — aksar woh jin par model sabse uncertain hai. Isse labeling budget bachta hai. Side effect: training distribution badal jata hai, kyunki model uncertain examples par zyada focus karta hai — yeh covariate shift ka cause hai. Isliye active learning ke fayde ke saath is side effect ko bhi interview me mention karo.
Q16Class imbalance ko kaise handle karein? Accuracy kyun misleading hoti hai?
99% accuracy ka matlab ho sakta hai ki model ne minority class ko kabhi predict hi nahi kiya. Isliye precision, recall, F1 aur PR curve use karo — highly imbalanced data me PR curve ROC se zyada informative hoti hai. Methods: undersampling (majority kam karo), oversampling (minority duplicate karo), cost-sensitive learning (minority ki galti ko zyada mehenga mano), class-balanced loss, aur focal loss (hard examples par focus). Evaluation hamesha original distribution par karo.
Q17Data augmentation karte time sabse badi galti kya hai?
Label-preserving transformations use karna — transformation ke baad label wahi rehna chahiye. Agar flip ya crop se label badal jaye, to augmentation galat hai. Perturbation se model robust banta hai, lekin neural networks ek pixel ke change se bhi galat predict kar sakte hain, isliye har augmentation ko validation par test karo. Synthetic data real data ki jagah poori tarah nahi le sakta.
Q18Missing values — MCAR, MAR, MNAR — aur deletion vs imputation?
MCAR me missing hona pure random hai, MAR me observed values par depend karta hai, MNAR me missing value khud par depend karta hai — jaise zyada income wale log income batana nahi chahte. MNAR sabse dangerous hai kyunki missing hona hi ek signal hai. Deletion simple hai lekin data waste karta hai aur bias la sakta hai. Imputation (mean/median/model se) data bachata hai, lekin galat imputation galat signal deta hai. Best practice: missingness ko khud ek feature banao, jaise age_missing binary feature.
Q19Scaling kab zaroori hai aur leakage se kaise bachein?
Distance-based aur gradient-based models ko scaling ki zyada zaroorat hoti hai; tree-based models ko kam. Standardization (z-score), min-max normalization, aur log transform (skewed data ke liye) common methods hain. Critical rule: scaling ke parameters sirf training data se compute karo — poore data par compute karke split karna leakage hai. Yahi rule imputation aur oversampling par bhi lagta hai: pehle split karo, phir transform karo.
Q20Data leakage kya hai? Interview me 6 causes kaise yaad rakhein?
Leakage tab hota hai jab training data me woh information aa jaye jo inference ke time available nahi hogi — model training me achha dikhega, production me fail hoga. 6 causes: time-correlated data ko randomly split karna, split se pehle scaling, split se pehle oversampling/augmentation, duplication ko handle na karna, group leakage (ek hi user/patient train aur test dono me), aur data collection se leakage. Detection: suspiciously high validation score, feature importance check, aur ablation.
Q21Feature importance ko blindly trust kyun nahi karna chahiye?
Correlated features me importance baant jata hai, aur ek feature important isliye bhi dikh sakta hai kyunki woh leaked hai. SHAP jaise methods single prediction aur overall model — dono ke liye contribution batate hain, lekin woh bhi sirf ek signal hain. Achha feature woh hai jo training ke bahar bhi kaam kare — alag time periods aur user groups par test karo. Aur yaad rakho: bekaar features technical debt hain, unki compute, storage aur maintenance cost hoti hai.
Q22Objective function aur business goal me gap kyun hota hai? Decoupling kya hai?
Model wahi optimize karta hai jo loss function me likha hai — jo business chahta hai woh nahi. Isliye objectives ko decouple karo: jaise feed quality ke liye pehle spam filter karo, phir NSFW aur misinformation filter karo, phir quality se rank karo. Har objective ko alag se measure aur improve kar sakte ho. Sab kuch ek model me daalne se pata nahi chalta ki kaunsa hissa fail ho raha hai.
Q23Model selection ke 6 tips kya hain?
State-of-the-art trap se bacho, sabse simple model se shuru karo, human biases se bacho, abhi achha vs baad me achha dekho (learning curves), trade-offs evaluate karo (accuracy ke saath latency, cost, interpretability), aur model ke assumptions samjho (IID, smoothness, conditional independence, normal distribution). Model ko data aur metrics se choose karo, preference se nahi.
Q24Bagging vs boosting vs stacking — kab kaunsa?
Bagging variance kam karta hai — unstable methods jaise trees aur neural networks par achha. Boosting bias kam karta hai — weak learners ko sequentially train karke, lekin overfitting aur slow training ka risk. Stacking me base learners ki predictions meta-learner ko di jati hain — diverse base learners hon to best. Ensembles accuracy badhate hain lekin deployment aur maintenance cost bhi badhate hain, isliye cost-benefit dekho.
Q25ML model ko debug kaise karte ho? 3 practical tips batao.
Simple se shuru karke dheere-dheere components add karo — taaki pata chale kaunsa component toota. Ek hi batch par overfit karke dekho — agar ek batch par bhi overfit nahi hota to pipeline me bug hai. Random seed set karo — taaki runs comparable hon. Aur aksar bug model me nahi, data me hota hai — isliye features aur data quality bhi check karo.
Q26Data parallelism vs model parallelism vs pipeline parallelism?
Data parallelism me data baanto, har machine par model ka poora copy train karo, gradients sync karo — SSGD me sab ek saath sync hote hain, ASGD me har machine apni speed par. Model parallelism me model ko hi baanto — jab model ek machine ki memory me fit na ho. Pipeline parallelism me micro-batches ko pipeline ki tarah process karo taaki koi machine idle na rahe. Dono ko combine bhi kar sakte ho.
Q27Baselines kyun zaroori hain? 5 baselines ke naam batao.
Metrics akele kuch nahi kehte — unka matlab baselines ke comparison me hota hai. 5 baselines: random baseline, simple heuristic, zero rule (hamesha majority class), human baseline, aur existing solutions (jo system abhi production me hai). Agar tumhara model simple heuristic se behtar nahi hai, to ML ki zaroorat hi nahi thi.
Q28Perturbation, invariance aur directional expectation tests kya hain?
Teeno behavioural tests hain. Perturbation: input me chhota change karo, prediction stable rehni chahiye. Invariance: aisa change jo prediction ko badalna nahi chahiye — jaise naam badalne se sentiment nahi badalna chahiye. Directional expectation: aisa change jo prediction ko expected direction me badle — jaise price badhne se demand kam honi chahiye. Yeh tests accuracy ke bahar model ke behaviour ko check karte hain.
Q29Calibration kya hai aur aggregation paradox kya sikhata hai?
Calibration ka matlab hai model ki confidence uski accuracy se match kare — 90% confident ho to 90% baar sahi hona chahiye. Calibration curves se overconfidence pata chalti hai. Aggregation paradox kehta hai ki aggregate metrics misleading ho sakte hain — overall ek group ke saath bias dikh sakta hai, lekin department-wise dekhne par picture ulta nikle. Isliye hamesha slice-based evaluation karo — alag groups, regions aur time periods par.
Q30Batch prediction vs online prediction — kaunsa kab choose karein?
Batch me predictions periodically banti hain — cheap, simple, high throughput, latency kam important. Online me request aate hi real-time predictions banti hain — latency critical, cost zyada, architecture complex. Online me sirf batch features ya batch + streaming features dono use ho sakte hain. Agar user ko turant result chahiye to online, agar result pehle se compute karke rakha ja sakta hai to batch kaafi hai.
Q31Train/serve skew kya hai aur use kaise rokein?
Training aur inference pipelines alag tareeke se features banayein to skew hota hai — model silently kharab perform karta hai. Yeh do alag pipelines rakhne ka sabse bada khatra hai. Solution: training aur inference ke liye ek hi code aur ek hi logic use karo — pipelines ko unify karo. Feature computation, data format ya preprocessing me koi bhi difference skew hai.
Q32Model compression ke 4 tareeke kya hain?
Low-rank factorization (bade matrices ko chhote matrices se approximate karo), knowledge distillation (bade teacher se chhote student ko sikhao), pruning (bekaar weights hata do), aur quantization (32-bit float ki jagah 8-bit integer — size 4x kam, inference tez). Har method ka accuracy se tradeoff hai, isliye use case ke hisaab se balance dhoondho.
Q33Cloud vs edge deployment — kaunsa kab?
Cloud me compute unlimited hai aur updates aasan hain, lekin network latency aur privacy issues hain. Edge me latency bahut kam hai, data device par rehta hai aur offline kaam karta hai, lekin compute aur memory limited hain. Hardware powerful hone se models cloud se edge ki taraf move ho rahe hain. Edge ke liye loop tiling, operator fusion aur auto-tuning jaise optimizations use hote hain.
Q34Covariate shift, label shift aur concept drift me kya farq hai?
Covariate shift: P(X) badla, P(Y|X) wahi — input distribution badla. Label shift: P(Y) badla, P(X|Y) wahi — output distribution badla. Concept drift: P(Y|X) badla, P(X) wahi — same input, different output, jaise COVID ke baad ghar ki keemat ka relation badal gaya. Asliyat me kai shifts ek saath hote hain, aur research me inke naam ko lekar confusion bhi hai.
Q35Degenerate feedback loop kya hai? Use kaise todein?
Jab system ke outputs wapas inputs ban jayein aur har round me bias badhe — jaise pehle position par dikhaya gaya gaana click hota hai, isliye aur zyada recommend hota hai. Metrics achhe dikhte hain lekin diversity khatm ho jati hai. Fix: inference me position feature ko neutral karo, ya do models use karo — ek visibility predict kare, doosra click predict kare. Exploration bhi zaroori hai — kabhi-kabhi naye items bhi dikhao.
Q36Data distribution shift ko detect kaise karein? Time window kyun matter karta hai?
Statistical tests se do distributions compare karo, aur input distribution ko labels ke bina monitor karo. Time window critical hai — chhota window false alarms deta hai, bada window real shifts ko chhupa deta hai. Cumulative accuracy sudden dips ko chhupa deti hai, isliye windowed metrics use karo. Industry me sabse common solution shift ke baad model ko retrain karna hai — kab aur kis data par retrain karein, yeh monitoring aur continual learning ka topic hai.
